class.name: OcgGceMakelin2d
class.brief_description: This class implements construction algorithms for `gp_Lin2d`. Supported constructions include: - line from axis placement; - line from point and direction; - line from cartesian equation; - parallel line through point or at signed distance; - line through two points.

method.name: from_gp_Ax2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates a line located with A.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Dir2d_const_ref
method.description: is the location point (origin) of the line and is the direction of the line.

method.name: from_gp_Lin2d_const_ref_double
method.description: Creates a line parallel to input line at signed distance.

method.name: from_gp_Lin2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates a line parallel to input line and passing through a point.

method.name: from_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref_gp_Pnt2d_const_ref
method.description: Creates a line passing through two points.

method.name: from_double_double_double
method.description: Creates the line from the equation A*X + B*Y + C = 0.0

method.name: Value
method.description: Returns the constructed line. Exceptions StdFail_NotDone if no line is constructed.

method.name: Operator
method.description: Alias for Value() returning a copy.
